map.轴力 N=1.3×(立杆自重+构配件重)+1.5×施工荷载；风荷载标准值 W_k: Axial force N=1.3×(post self-weight+fitting weight)+1.5×construction load; standard wind load W_k=μz·μs·w₀, wind moment Mw=0.9×1.4·W_k·a·h²/10; slenderness λ=μ×lift×1000÷radius of gyration i (l₀=μ·h, μ=1.6; Φ48×3.5 i=15.8mm); stability coefficient φ by λ table interpolation; stress σ=N×1000/(φ×A)+Mw×10⁶/W; safety factor K=205/σ, K≥1 safe.
map.K≥1 表示不考虑缺陷时满足，但实际脚手架含初弯曲、节点松动等，规范另有稳定承载: K≥1 means safe ignoring defects; actual scaffolds have initial bow and loose joints, and the code has a separate stability-capacity formula and construction requirements; K is a quick check only — formal check follows JGJ130.

map.脚手架立杆稳定（压弯组合）：轴力 N = 1.3×(立杆自重 0.0384H +: Scaffold post stability (compression-bending): axial force N = 1.3 × (post dead load 0.0384H + deck dead load 0.35 × spacing a × 1.05 × deck layers) + 1.5 × construction load q × a × 1.05 × 2 (GB 55023-2022 partial factors), deck layers = max(1, ⌊erection height ÷ (2 × lift height h)⌋); standard wind load W_k = μ_z × μ_s × w₀, wind moment Mw = 0.9 × 1.4 × W_k × a × h² ÷ 10 (JGJ 130-2011 §5.2.6); slenderness ratio λ = 1.6 × h × 1000 ÷ 15.8 (radius of gyration 15.8 mm), φ interpolated linearly from the λ table; stress σ = N × 1000 ÷ (φ × 489) + Mw × 10⁶ ÷ 5078 (MPa), stability ratio K = 205 ÷ σ. Validation: if any of q, w₀, a, h, H, μ_z, μ_s is not a number or the spacing/lift height is 0, prompt and return. Criterion: K ≥ 1 satisfied (≥ 1.5 ample margin, 1–1.5 basically satisfied), K < 1 not satisfied.
Post effective-length coefficient μ = 1.6 (typical for two-step-three-span / three-step-three-span); recalculate with 1.8–2.1 when wall ties are sparse.
